title.ur: Musalman safai ka khayal rakhta hai

intro.en: John and Imad talk about three kinds of cleanliness: the body, the clothes and the heart. Notice the phrase «عَلى كُلِّ مُسْلِم أَنْ …» (every Muslim must …).
intro.ur: Is sabaq mein John aur Imad safai ki teen qismon par baat karte hain: jism, kapde aur dil. Dhyan dein: «عَلى كُلِّ مُسْلِم أَنْ …» (har Musalman par lazim hai ke …).
intro.ar: جونُ وَعِمادٌ يَتَحَدَّثانِ عَنْ ثَلاثَةِ أَنْواعٍ مِنَ النَّظافَةِ: نَظافَةِ الجِسْمِ وَالثِّيابِ وَالقَلْبِ. اِنْتَبِهْ إِلى عِبارَةِ «عَلى كُلِّ مُسْلِمٍ أَنْ ...».

dialogue.ar: ما أَطْيَبَ العِطْرَ الَّذي تَسْتَعْمِلُهُ اليَوْمَ يا عِمادُ!
dialogue.tr: mā aṭyaba l-ʿiṭra lladhī tastaʿmiluhu l-yawma yā ʿImād
dialogue.en: What a lovely perfume you are using today, Imad!
dialogue.ur: Imad, aap aaj kitna achha itr laga rahe hain!

dialogue.ar: شُكْراً يا جون.
dialogue.tr: shukran yā Jūn
dialogue.en: Thank you, John.
dialogue.ur: Shukriya John.

dialogue.ar: أَراكَ تَهْتَمُّ بِالنَّظافَةِ كَثيراً.
dialogue.tr: arāka tahtammu bi-n-naẓāfati kathīran
dialogue.en: I see you care a lot about cleanliness.
dialogue.ur: Main dekhta hoon aap safai ka bahut khayal rakhte hain.

dialogue.ar: حَقّاً؛ لِأَنَّ الإِسْلامَ يَحُثُّ المُسْلِمَ عَلى النَّظافَةِ.
dialogue.tr: ḥaqqan; li-anna l-islāma yaḥuththu l-muslima ʿalā n-naẓāfa
dialogue.en: True, because Islam encourages the Muslim to be clean.
dialogue.ur: Sach hai, kyunke Islam Musalman ko safai par ubharta hai.

dialogue.ar: هَلْ يَهْتَمُّ كُلُّ المُسْلِمينَ بِالنَّظافَةِ مِثْلَكَ؟
dialogue.tr: hal yahtammu kullu l-muslimīna bi-n-naẓāfati mithlaka?
dialogue.en: Do all Muslims care about cleanliness like you?
dialogue.ur: Kya tamam Musalman aap ki tarah safai ka khayal rakhte hain?

dialogue.ar: نَعَمْ، لِأَنَّ عَلى كُلِّ مُسْلِم أَنْ يَتَوَضَّأَ، وَيَغْتَسِلَ، وَيَتَطَهَّرَ.
dialogue.tr: naʿam, li-anna ʿalā kulli muslimin an yatawaḍḍaʾa wa-yaghtasila wa-yataṭahhara
dialogue.en: Yes, because every Muslim must make wudu, wash and purify himself.
dialogue.ur: Haan, kyunke har Musalman par wuzu karna, ghusl karna aur paak rehna lazim hai.

dialogue.ar: هَذِهِ نَظافَةُ الجِسْمِ، وَماذا عَنْ نَظافَةِ المَلْبَسِ؟
dialogue.tr: hādhihi naẓāfatu l-jismi, wa-mādhā ʿan naẓāfati l-malbas?
dialogue.en: That is cleanliness of the body. What about cleanliness of clothes?
dialogue.ur: Yeh jism ki safai hui, aur kapdon ki safai ke baare mein kya?

dialogue.ar: يَهْتَمُّ المُسْلِمُ بِنَظافَةِ المَلْبَسِ، كَما يَهْتَمُّ بِنَظافَةِ الجِسْمِ، فَتَكونُ ثِيابُهُ نَظيفَةً دائِماً.
dialogue.tr: yahtammu l-muslimu bi-naẓāfati l-malbasi, kamā yahtammu bi-naẓāfati l-jismi, fa-takūnu thiyābuhu naẓīfatan dāʾiman
dialogue.en: A Muslim cares about clean clothes as he cares about a clean body, so his clothes are always clean.
dialogue.ur: Musalman kapdon ki safai ka bhi utna hi khayal rakhta hai jitna jism ka, is liye uske kapde hamesha saaf hote hain.

dialogue.ar: فِعْلاً، النَّظافَةُ أَمْرٌ مُهِمٌّ عِنْدَكُمْ.
dialogue.tr: fiʿlan, an-naẓāfatu amrun muhimmun ʿindakum
dialogue.en: Indeed, cleanliness is an important matter for you.
dialogue.ur: Waqai, safai aap ke haan ek ahem baat hai.

dialogue.ar: وَهُناكَ نَوْعٌ ثالِثٌ مِنَ النَّظافَةِ.
dialogue.tr: wa-hunāka nawʿun thālithun mina n-naẓāfa
dialogue.en: And there is a third kind of cleanliness.
dialogue.ur: Aur safai ki ek teesri qism bhi hai.

dialogue.ar: ما هُوَ؟
dialogue.tr: mā huwa?
dialogue.en: What is it?
dialogue.ur: Woh kya hai?

dialogue.ar: نَظافَةُ النَّفْسِ.
dialogue.tr: naẓāfatu n-nafs
dialogue.en: Cleanliness of the soul.
dialogue.ur: Nafs (dil o rooh) ki safai.

dialogue.ar: ماذا تَقْصِدُ؟
dialogue.tr: mādhā taqṣidu?
dialogue.en: What do you mean?
dialogue.ur: Aap ka kya matlab hai?

dialogue.ar: يَجِبُ أَنْ يَكونَ المُسْلِمُ نَظيفَ القَلْبِ، يُحِبُّ الخَيْرَ لِأَخيهِ، كَما يُحِبُّهُ لِنَفْسِهِ.
dialogue.tr: yajibu an yakūna l-muslimu naẓīfa l-qalbi, yuḥibbu l-khayra li-akhīhi, kamā yuḥibbuhu li-nafsihi
dialogue.en: A Muslim must have a clean heart, loving good for his brother as he loves it for himself.
dialogue.ur: Musalman ka dil saaf hona chahiye, woh apne bhai ke liye wohi achhai chahe jo apne liye chahta hai.

dialogue.ar: شُكْراً يا عِمادُ؛ فَقَدْ تَعَلَّمْتُ مِنْكَ اليَوْمَ الكَثيرَ.
dialogue.tr: shukran yā ʿImād; faqad taʿallamtu minka l-yawma l-kathīr
dialogue.en: Thank you, Imad; I learned a lot from you today.
dialogue.ur: Shukriya Imad, aaj maine aap se bahut kuch seekha.

dialogue.ar: عَفْواً، وَإِلى لِقاء.
dialogue.tr: ʿafwan, wa-ilā liqāʾ
dialogue.en: You're welcome, see you soon.
dialogue.ur: Koi baat nahin, phir milenge.

q.en: What are the three kinds of cleanliness Imad mentions?
q.ur: Imad safai ki kaun si teen qismein batate hain?
q.ar: ما أَنْواعُ النَّظافَةِ الثَّلاثَةُ الَّتي يَذْكُرُها عِمادٌ؟

q.ur: «يَتَوَضَّأُ» ka matlab kya hai?

q.en: According to Imad, why does a Muslim care about cleanliness?
q.ur: Imad ke mutabiq Musalman safai ka khayal kyun rakhta hai?
q.ar: لِماذا يَهْتَمُّ المُسْلِمُ بِالنَّظافَةِ حَسَبَ عِمادٍ؟

q.ur: «نَظيفُ القَلْبِ» kis ke baare mein hai?

options: Someone with a clean heart who loves good for his brother
options_ar: مَنْ قَلْبُهُ صافٍ يُحِبُّ الخَيْرَ لِأَخيهِ

q.ur: Kaun sa lafz "libaas" ka matlab deta hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ كَلِمَةٍ تَعْني ما يَلْبَسُهُ الإِنْسانُ؟

title.ur: Ra ko moti aur patli parhna

intro.en: The letter ر can be pronounced heavy (مُفَخَّمَة) or light (مُرَقَّقَة). With a kasra it is light: رِحال. With a fatha or damma it is heavy: رَجُل، رُسُل. A silent ر depends on the vowel before it.
intro.ur: Harf ر kabhi moti (مُفَخَّمَة) aur kabhi patli (مُرَقَّقَة) parha jata hai. Zer ke saath patli: رِحال. Zabar ya pesh ke saath moti: رَجُل، رُسُل. Sakin ر ka faisla us se pehle wali harkat se hota hai.
intro.ar: الرّاءُ تَكونُ مُفَخَّمَةً أَوْ مُرَقَّقَةً. مَعَ الكَسْرَةِ تُرَقَّقُ مِثْلَ: رِحال. وَمَعَ الفَتْحَةِ أَوِ الضَّمَّةِ تُفَخَّمُ مِثْلَ: رَجُل، رُسُل. وَالرّاءُ السّاكِنَةُ يَتْبَعُ حُكْمُها الحَرَكَةَ الَّتي قَبْلَها.

q.en: How is a ر with a kasra pronounced?
q.ur: Zer wali ر kaise parhi jati hai?

q.en: Which word has a heavy ر?
q.ur: Kis lafz mein moti ر hai?

q.en: Which word has a light ر?
q.ur: Kis lafz mein patli ر hai?

q.en: A silent ر after a damma (as in غُرْفَة) is:
q.ur: Pesh ke baad sakin ر (jaise غُرْفَة) hoti hai:
q.ar: الرّاءُ السّاكِنَةُ بَعْدَ ضَمَّةٍ (كَما في «غُرْفَة») تُنْطَقُ:

intro.en: Relative pronouns mean "who / which / that". الَّذي = masculine singular; الَّتي = feminine singular (and broken plurals of things); اللَّذانِ / اللَّتانِ = dual (m / f); الَّذينَ = masculine plural; اللَّاتي / اللائي = feminine plural. Example: الحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذي أَنْزَلَ عَلى عَبْدِهِ الكِتابَ.
intro.ur: Ism-e-mausool ka matlab "jo / jis ne". الَّذي = ek mard (mufrad muzakkar); الَّتي = ek aurat (aur beaql cheezon ki jama); اللَّذانِ / اللَّتانِ = tasniya (mard / aurat); الَّذينَ = mardon ki jama; اللَّاتي / اللائي = aurton ki jama. Misaal: الحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذي أَنْزَلَ عَلى عَبْدِهِ الكِتابَ.
intro.ar: الأَسْماءُ المَوْصولَةُ: الَّذي لِلْمُفْرَدِ المُذَكَّرِ، الَّتي لِلْمُفْرَدِ المُؤَنَّثِ، اللَّذانِ وَاللَّتانِ لِلْمُثَنّى، الَّذينَ لِجَمْعِ المُذَكَّرِ، اللّاتي وَاللّائي لِجَمْعِ المُؤَنَّثِ. مِثالٌ: الحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذي أَنْزَلَ عَلى عَبْدِهِ الكِتابَ.

q.en: Which relative pronoun is for a masculine singular noun?
q.ur: Mufrad muzakkar ke liye kaun sa ism-e-mausool hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ اسْمٍ مَوْصولٍ نَسْتَعْمِلُهُ لِلْمُفْرَدِ المُذَكَّرِ؟

q.ur: Do auraton ke liye kaun sa hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ اسْمٍ مَوْصولٍ نَسْتَعْمِلُهُ لِلْمُثَنّى المُؤَنَّثِ (امْرَأَتَيْنِ)؟

q.en: Which is for a group of males?
q.ur: Mardon ki jama ke liye kaun sa hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ اسْمٍ مَوْصولٍ نَسْتَعْمِلُهُ لِجَماعَةِ الذُّكورِ؟

q.ur: Mukammal karein: هذانِ الطّالِبانِ ___ فازا بالجائِزَةِ.

intro.en: Listen to a dialogue about a dirty neighbourhood and answer the questions (why Amir wants to leave, why the residents will meet, where they put rubbish, how often they will clean). Then ask your partner about cleanliness habits using كَمْ مَرَّة and مَتى.
intro.ur: Mohalle ke ganda hone par ek mukaalma suniye aur sawalon ke jawab dein. Phir apne saathi se safai ki aadaton ke baare mein كَمْ مَرَّة (kitni baar) aur مَتى (kab) se sawal poochhein.
intro.ar: اِسْتَمِعْ إِلى حِوارٍ عَنْ حَيٍّ سَكَنِيٍّ مُتَّسِخٍ وَأَجِبْ عَنِ الأَسْئِلَةِ: لِماذا يُريدُ أَميرٌ أَنْ يَنْتَقِلَ، وَلِماذا سَيَجْتَمِعُ السُّكّانُ، وَأَيْنَ يَضَعونَ القُمامَةَ، وَكَمْ مَرَّةً سَيُنَظِّفونَ. ثُمَّ اسْأَلْ زَميلَكَ عَنْ عاداتِ النَّظافَةِ بِـ«كَمْ مَرَّةً» وَ«مَتى».

q.ur: «كَمْ مَرَّةً تُنَظِّفُ أَسْنانَكَ؟» kis ke baare mein hai?
q.ar: ماذا نَسْأَلُ بِقَوْلِنا «كَمْ مَرَّةً تُنَظِّفُ أَسْنانَكَ؟»

options: How many times you clean your teeth

q.ur: «الأَوْساخُ» ka matlab?
«مَتى يَتَوَضَّأُ المُسْلِمُ؟» poochta hai:

options: When does a Muslim make wudu?

q.ur: «يُنَظِّفُ» ka matlab:

intro.en: A reading passage about how Islam calls to cleanliness and purity: wudu, ghusl, and clean clothes. It quotes Qur'an verses and hadith; the book's wording is kept.
intro.ur: Ek parhne ka matn ke Islam safai aur paaki ki taraf kaise bulata hai: wuzu, ghusl aur saaf kapde. Is mein Quran ki ayaat aur ahadees aayi hain, kitab ke alfaz hi rakhe gaye hain.
intro.ar: نَصٌّ لِلْقِراءَةِ عَنْ دَعْوَةِ الإِسْلامِ إِلى النَّظافَةِ وَالطَّهارَةِ: الوُضوءُ وَالغُسْلُ وَالثِّيابُ النَّظيفَةُ. يَذْكُرُ النَّصُّ آياتٍ وَأَحاديثَ، وَقَدْ حُفِظَتْ أَلْفاظُ الكِتابِ كَما هِيَ.

dialogue.ar: دَعا الإِسْلامُ إِلى النَّظافَةِ وَالطَّهارَةِ.
dialogue.tr: daʿā l-islāmu ilā n-naẓāfati wa-ṭ-ṭahāra
dialogue.en: Islam called to cleanliness and purity.
dialogue.ur: Islam ne safai aur paaki ki dawat di.

dialogue.ar: قالَ تَعالى: ﴿إِنَّ اللَّهَ يُحِبُّ التَّوّابينَ وَيُحِبُّ المُتَطَهِّرينَ﴾.
dialogue.tr: qāla taʿālā: inna llāha yuḥibbu t-tawwābīna wa-yuḥibbu l-mutaṭahhirīn
dialogue.en: Allah the Exalted said: Indeed Allah loves those who repent and loves those who purify themselves.
dialogue.ur: Allah Ta'ala ne farmaya: beshak Allah tauba karne walon aur paak rehne walon se mohabbat karta hai.

dialogue.ar: وَأَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ الماءَ مِنَ السَّماءِ؛ لِيَتَطَهَّرَ بِهِ الإِنْسانُ.
dialogue.tr: wa-anzala llāhu l-māʾa mina s-samāʾi; li-yataṭahhara bihi l-insān
dialogue.en: Allah sent down water from the sky so that people may purify themselves with it.
dialogue.ur: Allah ne aasman se pani utara taake insan us se paaki hasil kare.

dialogue.ar: وَحَثَّ الإِسْلامُ المُسْلِمَ عَلى نَظافَةِ جَسَدِهِ وَمَلْبَسِهِ وَمَسْكَنِهِ، وَالبيئَةِ الَّتي يَعيشُ فيها.
dialogue.tr: wa-ḥaththa l-islāmu l-muslima ʿalā naẓāfati jasadihi wa-malbasihi wa-maskanihi wa-l-bīʾati llatī yaʿīshu fīhā
dialogue.en: Islam urged the Muslim to keep his body, clothes, home and surroundings clean.
dialogue.ur: Islam ne Musalman ko apne jism, libaas, ghar aur mahaul ki safai par ubhara.

dialogue.ar: يَتَوَضَّأُ المُسْلِمُ في اليَوْمِ خَمْسَ مَرّاتٍ لِلصَّلاةِ.
dialogue.tr: yatawaḍḍaʾu l-muslimu fī l-yawmi khamsa marrātin li-ṣ-ṣalāh
dialogue.en: A Muslim makes wudu five times a day for prayer.
dialogue.ur: Musalman din mein paanch baar namaz ke liye wuzu karta hai.

dialogue.ar: كَما يَتَوَضَّأُ لِأَداءِ عِباداتٍ أُخْرى، مِثْلَ: قِراءَةِ القُرْآنِ، وَالطَّوافِ حَوْلَ البَيْتِ.
dialogue.tr: kamā yatawaḍḍaʾu li-adāʾi ʿibādātin ukhrā, mithla qirāʾati l-qurʾān wa-ṭ-ṭawāfi ḥawla l-bayt
dialogue.en: He also makes wudu for other acts of worship, such as reciting the Qur'an and circling the House (tawaf).
dialogue.ur: Woh doosri ibadaat ke liye bhi wuzu karta hai, jaise Quran parhna aur Kaabe ka tawaf.

dialogue.ar: وَعِنْدَ الوُضوءِ يَغْسِلُ الإِنْسانُ وَجْهَهُ، وَيَدَيْهِ، وَرِجْلَيْهِ.
dialogue.tr: wa-ʿinda l-wuḍūʾi yaghsilu l-insānu wajhahu wa-yadayhi wa-rijlayh
dialogue.en: In wudu a person washes his face, his hands and his feet.
dialogue.ur: Wuzu mein insan apna chehra, haath aur paaon dhota hai.

dialogue.ar: إِنَّ الوُضوءَ نَظافَةٌ مُسْتَمِرَّةٌ لِلْجِسْمِ، تَتَكَرَّرُ في اليَوْمِ كَثيراً؛ فَيُزيلُ الأَوْساخَ.
dialogue.tr: inna l-wuḍūʾa naẓāfatun mustamirratun li-l-jismi, tatakarraru fī l-yawmi kathīran; fa-yuzīlu l-awsākh
dialogue.en: Wudu is continuous cleanliness of the body, repeated many times a day, removing dirt.
dialogue.ur: Wuzu jism ki musalsal safai hai jo din mein kai baar hoti hai aur ganda door karti hai.

dialogue.ar: لا يَكْتَفي المُسْلِمُ بِالوُضوءِ وَحْدَهُ، بَلْ يُضيفُ إِلى ذَلِكَ الغُسْلَ؛ لِنَظافَةِ الجِسْمِ كُلِّهِ.
dialogue.tr: lā yaktafī l-muslimu bi-l-wuḍūʾi waḥdahu, bal yuḍīfu ilā dhālika l-ghusl; li-naẓāfati l-jismi kullih
dialogue.en: A Muslim is not content with wudu alone; he adds ghusl to it, to clean the whole body.
dialogue.ur: Musalman sirf wuzu par iktifa nahin karta balkay ghusl bhi karta hai taake poora jism saaf ho.

dialogue.ar: وَيَهْتَمُّ المُسْلِمُ بِنَظافَةِ ثَوْبِهِ، كَما يَهْتَمُّ بِنَظافَةِ جِسْمِهِ. قالَ تَعالى: ﴿وَثِيابَكَ فَطَهِّرْ﴾.
dialogue.tr: wa-yahtammu l-muslimu bi-naẓāfati thawbihi, kamā yahtammu bi-naẓāfati jismih. qāla taʿālā: wa-thiyābaka faṭahhir
dialogue.en: A Muslim cares about clean clothes as about a clean body. Allah said: And purify your clothes.
dialogue.ur: Musalman kapdon ki safai ka bhi khayal rakhta hai. Allah ne farmaya: aur apne kapde paak rakho.

q.en: How many times a day does a Muslim make wudu for prayer (as in the text)?
q.ur: Matn ke mutabiq Musalman namaz ke liye din mein kitni baar wuzu karta hai?
q.ar: كَمْ مَرَّةً في اليَوْمِ يَتَوَضَّأُ المُسْلِمُ لِلصَّلاةِ (كَما في النَّصِّ)؟

q.en: Which is NOT washed in wudu in the text?
q.ur: Matn mein wuzu mein kaun sa hissa dhone ka zikr nahin?
q.ar: أَيُّ عُضْوٍ لا يُغْسَلُ في الوُضوءِ في النَّصِّ؟

q.en: What does a Muslim add to wudu to clean the whole body?
q.ur: Poora jism saaf karne ke liye Musalman wuzu ke saath kya karta hai?
q.ar: ماذا يُضيفُ المُسْلِمُ إِلى الوُضوءِ لِتَنْظيفِ الجِسْمِ كُلِّهِ؟

q.ur: «الطَّهارَةُ» ka matlab:

q.en: What did Allah send down from the sky for purification?
q.ur: Paaki ke liye Allah ne aasman se kya utara?
q.ar: ماذا أَنْزَلَ اللهُ مِنَ السَّماءِ لِلتَّطْهيرِ؟

intro.en: The dual means exactly two. Add ـانِ (alif + nūn) to the noun in the nominative (قَلَمانِ), and ـيْنِ (yā' + nūn) in the accusative or genitive (قَلَمَيْنِ). Example: الطّالِبانِ حَضَرا (two students came) / قابَلْتُ الصَّديقَيْنِ (I met the two friends).
intro.ur: Muthanna (tasniya) matlab bilkul do. Marfu halat mein ـانِ lagta hai (قَلَمانِ) aur mansub ya majroor mein ـيْنِ (قَلَمَيْنِ). Misaal: الطّالِبانِ حَضَرا (do talib-e-ilm aaye) / قابَلْتُ الصَّديقَيْنِ (main do doston se mila).
intro.ar: المُثَنّى يَدُلُّ عَلى اثْنَيْنِ بِالضَّبْطِ. نُضيفُ «ـانِ» إِلى الاسْمِ في حالَةِ الرَّفْعِ (قَلَمانِ)، وَ«ـيْنِ» في حالَتَيِ النَّصْبِ وَالجَرِّ (قَلَمَيْنِ). مِثالٌ: الطّالِبانِ حَضَرا، وَقابَلْتُ الصَّديقَيْنِ.

q.en: What is the dual of «قَلَم» in the nominative?
q.ur: «قَلَم» ka marfu tasniya kya hai?
Mukammal karein: قابَلْتُ الصَّديق___

q.en: Which one is a dual noun?
q.ur: Inmein se kaun sa tasniya hai?
Tasniya kis ke liye aata hai?
«عَيْنانِ» ka matlab:

intro.en: A family decides to eat dinner out at a fast-food restaurant, but afterwards everyone feels sick. Learn useful phrases: «أَشْعُرُ بِآلام» (I feel pains) and «لَنْ أَتَناوَلَ» (I will never eat).
intro.ur: Ek khandan raat ka khana bahar fast food mein khane ka faisla karta hai, lekin baad mein sab ki tabiyat kharab ho jati hai. Mufeed jumle seekhein: «أَشْعُرُ بِآلام» (mujhe dard ho raha hai) aur «لَنْ أَتَناوَلَ» (main hargiz nahin khaunga).
intro.ar: تَقَرِّرُ أُسْرَةٌ أَنْ تَتَعَشّى في مَطْعَمِ وَجَباتٍ سَريعَةٍ، وَبَعْدَ ذَلِكَ يَشْعُرُ الجَميعُ بِالمَرَضِ. تَعَلَّمْ عِباراتٍ مُفيدَةً: «أَشْعُرُ بِآلامٍ» وَ«لَنْ أَتَناوَلَ».

dialogue.ar: نُريدُ تَناوُلَ العَشاءِ اللَّيْلَةَ خارِجَ البَيْتِ.
dialogue.tr: nurīdu tanāwula l-ʿashāʾi l-laylata khārija l-bayt
dialogue.en: We want to have dinner outside the house tonight.
dialogue.ur: Hum aaj raat ka khana ghar se bahar khana chahte hain.

dialogue.ar: فِكْرَةٌ مُمْتازَةٌ، أَنا أُحِبُّ الأَكْلاتِ السَّريعَةَ.
dialogue.tr: fikratun mumtāza, anā uḥibbu l-aklāti s-sarīʿa
dialogue.en: An excellent idea, I love fast food.
dialogue.ur: Bahut umda khayal, mujhe fast food pasand hai.

dialogue.ar: وَلَكِنَّ طَعامَ البَيْتِ أَفْضَلُ؛ فَهُوَ لَذيذٌ، وَنَظيفٌ، وَصِحِّيٌّ.
dialogue.tr: wa-lākinna ṭaʿāma l-bayti afḍal; fa-huwa ladhīdhun wa-naẓīfun wa-ṣiḥḥiyy
dialogue.en: But home food is better; it is tasty, clean and healthy.
dialogue.ur: Lekin ghar ka khana behtar hai; woh lazeez, saaf aur sehatmand hai.

dialogue.ar: سَأُعِدُّ لَكُمُ اللَّيْلَةَ عَشاءً لَذيذاً.
dialogue.tr: sa-uʿiddu lakumu l-layla ʿashāʾan ladhīdhan
dialogue.en: Tonight I will prepare a delicious dinner for you.
dialogue.ur: Aaj raat main aap ke liye lazeez khana banaungi.

dialogue.ar: لا يا أُمّي. نَحْنُ نُحِبُّ الأَكْلاتِ السَّريعَةَ.
dialogue.tr: lā yā ummī. naḥnu nuḥibbu l-aklāti s-sarīʿa
dialogue.en: No, Mother. We love fast food.
dialogue.ur: Nahin ammi. Hamein fast food pasand hai.

dialogue.ar: إِذَنْ، هَيّا بِنا نَتَناوَلِ العَشاءَ اللَّيْلَةَ في الخارِجِ.
dialogue.tr: idhan, hayyā binā natanāwali l-ʿashāʾa l-layla fī l-khārij
dialogue.en: Then come on, let's have dinner outside tonight.
dialogue.ur: Theek hai, chalo aaj raat ka khana bahar khate hain.

dialogue.ar: أَشْعُرُ بِآلامٍ شَديدَةٍ في المَعِدَةِ.
dialogue.tr: ashʿuru bi-ālāmin shadīdatin fī l-maʿida
dialogue.en: I feel severe pains in my stomach.
dialogue.ur: Mujhe pait mein shadeed dard ho raha hai.

dialogue.ar: وَأَنا أَيْضاً! آهِ! آهِ! بَطْني بَطْني!
dialogue.tr: wa-anā ayḍan! āh! āh! baṭnī baṭnī
dialogue.en: Me too! Ouch! My stomach, my stomach!
dialogue.ur: Mujhe bhi! Aah! Mera pait, mera pait!

dialogue.ar: وَأَنا كَذَلِكَ.
dialogue.tr: wa-anā kadhālika
dialogue.en: And me too.
dialogue.ur: Aur mujhe bhi.

dialogue.ar: سَأَطْلُبُ سَيّارَةَ الإِسْعافِ حالاً. رُبَّما كانَ هَذا تَسَمُّماً.
dialogue.tr: sa-aṭlubu sayyārata l-isʿāfi ḥālan. rubbamā kāna hādhā tasammuman
dialogue.en: I will call an ambulance right now. Perhaps this is food poisoning.
dialogue.ur: Main abhi ambulance bulati hoon. Shayad yeh zehar-khurani hai.

dialogue.ar: لاحَظْتُ أَنَّ المَطْعَمَ غَيْرُ نَظيفٍ، وَكَذَلِكَ عُمّالُ المَطْعَمِ.
dialogue.tr: lāḥaẓtu anna l-maṭʿama ghayru naẓīf, wa-kadhālika ʿummālu l-maṭʿam
dialogue.en: I noticed the restaurant was not clean, and so were its workers.
dialogue.ur: Maine dekha ke restaurant saaf nahin tha, aur uske kaarkun bhi.

dialogue.ar: وَكانَتِ المائِدَةُ وَالأَطْباقُ وَالأَكْوابُ مُتَّسِخَةً.
dialogue.tr: wa-kānati l-māʾidatu wa-l-aṭbāqu wa-l-akwābu muttasikha
dialogue.en: And the table, plates and cups were dirty.
dialogue.ur: Aur mez, plateein aur gilas ganday thay.

dialogue.ar: لَنْ أَتَناوَلَ الطَّعامَ مَرَّةً أُخْرى خارِجَ البَيْتِ.
dialogue.tr: lan atanāwala ṭ-ṭaʿāma marratan ukhrā khārija l-bayt
dialogue.en: I will never eat out again.
dialogue.ur: Main dobara kabhi ghar se bahar khana nahin khaungi.

dialogue.ar: ها هِيَ سَيّارَةُ الإِسْعافِ قَدْ وَصَلَتْ.
dialogue.tr: hā hiya sayyāratu l-isʿāfi qad waṣalat
dialogue.en: Here, the ambulance has arrived.
dialogue.ur: Yeh lo, ambulance pahunch gayi.

q.en: Where did the family feel pain?
q.ur: Khandan ko kahan dard hua?

q.en: What did the mother think caused it?
q.ur: Ammi ke khayal mein iski wajah kya thi?

q.en: Which did the father say was better, home food or restaurant food?
q.ur: Abbu ne kaun sa khana behtar kaha?
q.ar: أَيُّ الطَّعامَيْنِ أَفْضَلُ في رَأْيِ الأَبِ؟

q.ur: «لَذيذٌ» ka matlab?
"Ambulance" ke liye kaun sa lafz hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ كَلِمَةٍ تَعْني المَرْكَبَةَ الَّتي تَنْقُلُ المَرْضى؟

intro.en: Learn the question words and what each one asks about: مَنْ (who), ما / ماذا (what), أَيْنَ (where), مَتى (when), لِماذا (why), كَيْفَ (how), كَمْ (how many), أَيّ (which), هَلْ / أَ (yes/no questions).
intro.ur: Sawal ke alfaz aur unka istemal seekhein: مَنْ (kaun), ما / ماذا (kya), أَيْنَ (kahan), مَتى (kab), لِماذا (kyun), كَيْفَ (kaise), كَمْ (kitna), أَيّ (kaun sa), هَلْ / أَ (haan ya nahin wale sawal).
intro.ar: تَعَلَّمْ أَدَواتِ الاسْتِفْهامِ وَما تَسْأَلُ عَنْهُ كُلُّ أَداةٍ: مَنْ لِلشَّخْصِ، ما وَماذا لِلشَّيْءِ، أَيْنَ لِلْمَكانِ، مَتى لِلزَّمانِ، لِماذا لِلسَّبَبِ، كَيْفَ لِلْحالِ، كَمْ لِلْعَدَدِ، أَيّ لِلتَّعْيينِ، وَهَلْ وَالهَمْزَةُ لِسُؤالٍ جَوابُهُ نَعَمْ أَوْ لا.

q.en: Which question word asks about a place?
q.ur: Jagah ke liye kaun sa sawali lafz hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ أَداةِ اسْتِفْهامٍ نَسْأَلُ بِها عَنِ المَكانِ؟

q.ur: Waqt ke liye kaun sa hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ أَداةِ اسْتِفْهامٍ نَسْأَلُ بِها عَنِ الزَّمانِ؟

q.ur: Wajah poochne ke liye kaun sa hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ أَداةِ اسْتِفْهامٍ نَسْأَلُ بِها عَنِ السَّبَبِ؟

q.ur: «كَمْ طِفْلاً لَكَ؟» kis ke baare mein hai?
«هَلْ تُحِبُّ الشّايَ؟» ka jawab hota hai:

title.ur: Sunna aur khane ke baare mein baat

intro.en: Listen to a text about two brothers, Imad and Alaa, who differ in clothes, manners and cleanliness, then choose the right answers. After that, talk with a partner about where and when you eat and whether you like fast food.
intro.ur: Do bhaiyon Imad aur Alaa ke baare mein ek matn suniye jo libaas, akhlaq aur safai mein mukhtalif hain, phir sahi jawab chuniye. Uske baad saathi se baat karein ke aap kahan aur kab khana khate hain aur kya fast food pasand hai.
intro.ar: اِسْتَمِعْ إِلى نَصٍّ عَنْ أَخَوَيْنِ، عِمادٍ وَعَلاءٍ، يَخْتَلِفانِ في اللِّباسِ وَالأَخْلاقِ وَالنَّظافَةِ، ثُمَّ اخْتَرِ الإِجاباتِ الصَّحيحَةَ. بَعْدَ ذَلِكَ تَحَدَّثْ مَعَ زَميلِكَ عَنْ مَكانِ الأَكْلِ وَوَقْتِهِ وَهَلْ تُحِبُّ الوَجَباتِ السَّريعَةَ.

q.ur: «يُفَضِّلُ» ka matlab:
«طَيِّبُ الكَلامِ» kaisa shakhs hai?
«أَخَوانِ» hai:
«الأَخْلاقُ» ka matlab:

intro.en: A reading about private cleanliness (body, clothes, food, home) and public cleanliness (streets and gardens), and who is responsible for each. It also mentions the hadith about removing harm from the road.
intro.ur: Ek matn jis mein zaati safai (jism, kapde, khana, ghar) aur aam safai (sadkein aur baagh) aur har ek ki zimmedari ka bayan hai. Rasool Allah ﷺ ke us farman ka bhi zikr hai jis mein raste se takleef-deh cheez hatane ko sadaqa kaha gaya.
intro.ar: نَصٌّ عَنِ النَّظافَةِ الخاصَّةِ (الجِسْمِ وَالثِّيابِ وَالطَّعامِ وَالبَيْتِ) وَالنَّظافَةِ العامَّةِ (الشَّوارِعِ وَالحَدائِقِ) وَمَنِ المَسْؤولُ عَنْ كُلٍّ مِنْهُما. وَفيهِ حَديثُ إِماطَةِ الأَذى عَنِ الطَّريقِ.

dialogue.ar: النَّظافَةُ نَوْعانِ: نَظافَةٌ خاصَّةٌ، وَنَظافَةٌ عامَّةٌ.
dialogue.tr: an-naẓāfatu nawʿāni: naẓāfatun khāṣṣa wa-naẓāfatun ʿāmma
dialogue.en: Cleanliness is of two kinds: private and public.
dialogue.ur: Safai do qism ki hai: khaas (zaati) aur aam.

dialogue.ar: فَالنَّظافَةُ الخاصَّةُ نَظافَةُ جِسْمِ الإِنْسانِ وَثَوْبِهِ وَطَعامِهِ وَبَيْتِهِ.
dialogue.tr: fa-n-naẓāfatu l-khāṣṣatu naẓāfatu jismi l-insāni wa-thawbihi wa-ṭaʿāmihi wa-baytih
dialogue.en: Private cleanliness is the cleanliness of a person's body, clothes, food and home.
dialogue.ur: Khaas safai insan ke jism, kapdon, khane aur ghar ki safai hai.

dialogue.ar: أَمّا النَّظافَةُ العامَّةُ، فَنَظافَةُ الأَماكِنِ العامَّةِ، كَالشَّوارِعِ وَالحَدائِقِ.
dialogue.tr: ammā n-naẓāfatu l-ʿāmma, fa-naẓāfatu l-amākini l-ʿāmma, ka-sh-shawāriʿi wa-l-ḥadāʾiq
dialogue.en: Public cleanliness is the cleanliness of public places, like streets and gardens.
dialogue.ur: Aam safai aam jagahon ki safai hai, jaise sadkein aur baagh.

dialogue.ar: وَتَقَعُ مَسْؤولِيَّةُ النَّظافَةِ الخاصَّةِ عَلى الأَفْرادِ.
dialogue.tr: wa-taqaʿu masʾūliyyatu n-naẓāfati l-khāṣṣati ʿalā l-afrād
dialogue.en: Responsibility for private cleanliness falls on individuals.
dialogue.ur: Khaas safai ki zimmedari afrad par hai.

dialogue.ar: أَمّا مَسْؤولِيَّةُ النَّظافَةِ العامَّةِ، فَتَقَعُ عَلى الأَفْرادِ وَالحُكوماتِ.
dialogue.tr: ammā masʾūliyyatu n-naẓāfati l-ʿāmma, fa-taqaʿu ʿalā l-afrādi wa-l-ḥukūmāt
dialogue.en: Responsibility for public cleanliness falls on individuals and governments.
dialogue.ur: Aam safai ki zimmedari afrad aur hukumaton dono par hai.

dialogue.ar: يُقاسُ تَقَدُّمُ الدُّوَلِ اليَوْمَ بِالنَّظافَةِ.
dialogue.tr: yuqāsu taqaddumu d-duwali l-yawma bi-n-naẓāfa
dialogue.en: Today the progress of countries is measured by cleanliness.
dialogue.ur: Aaj mulkon ki taraqqi safai se naapi jati hai.

dialogue.ar: فَإِذا كانَتِ الدَّوْلَةُ وَسُكّانُها يَهْتَمّونَ بِالنَّظافَةِ، فَهِيَ دَوْلَةٌ مُتَحَضِّرَةٌ.
dialogue.tr: fa-idhā kānati d-dawlatu wa-sukkānuhā yahtammūna bi-n-naẓāfa, fa-hiya dawlatun mutaḥaḍḍira
dialogue.en: If a country and its people care about cleanliness, it is a civilised country.
dialogue.ur: Agar koi mulk aur uske rehne wale safai ka khayal rakhte hain to woh mutamaddin mulk hai.

dialogue.ar: وَإِذا كانَتِ الدَّوْلَةُ وَسُكّانُها لا يَهْتَمّونَ بِالنَّظافَةِ، فَهِيَ دَوْلَةٌ مُتَخَلِّفَةٌ.
dialogue.tr: wa-idhā kānati d-dawlatu wa-sukkānuhā lā yahtammūna bi-n-naẓāfa, fa-hiya dawlatun mutakhallifa
dialogue.en: If they do not care, it is a backward country.
dialogue.ur: Aur agar woh safai ka khayal nahin rakhte to woh pichhra hua mulk hai.

dialogue.ar: وَتُنْفِقُ بَعْضُ الدُّوَلِ أَمْوالاً كَثيرَةً عَلى النَّظافَةِ.
dialogue.tr: wa-tunfiqu baʿḍu d-duwali amwālan kathīratan ʿalā n-naẓāfa
dialogue.en: Some countries spend a lot of money on cleanliness.
dialogue.ur: Kuch mulk safai par bohat sa maal kharch karte hain.

dialogue.ar: وَيُشارِكُ المُواطِنُ الدَّوْلَةَ في الاهْتِمامِ بِالنَّظافَةِ، حَيْثُ يَضَعُ النُّفاياتِ الخاصَّةَ بِبَيْتِهِ في الحاوِياتِ.
dialogue.tr: wa-yushāriku l-muwāṭinu d-dawlata fī l-ihtimāmi bi-n-naẓāfa, ḥaythu yaḍaʿu n-nufāyāti l-khāṣṣata bi-baytihi fī l-ḥāwiyāt
dialogue.en: The citizen shares with the state in caring for cleanliness, by putting his household waste in the bins.
dialogue.ur: Shehri riyasat ke saath safai mein hissa leta hai, apne ghar ka kooda dibbon mein dalkar.

dialogue.ar: وَهَذا ما دَعا إِلَيْهِ الرَّسولُ ﷺ في قَوْلِهِ: «إِماطَةُ الأَذى عَنِ الطَّريقِ صَدَقَةٌ».
dialogue.tr: wa-hādhā mā daʿā ilayhi r-rasūlu ṣallā llāhu ʿalayhi wa-sallam fī qawlih: imāṭatu l-adhā ʿani ṭ-ṭarīqi ṣadaqa
dialogue.en: This is what the Messenger ﷺ called to when he said: Removing harm from the road is charity.
dialogue.ur: Yehi baat Rasool Allah ﷺ ne farmayi: raste se takleef-deh cheez hatana sadaqa hai.

q.en: How many kinds of cleanliness does the text mention?
q.ur: Matn mein safai ki kitni qismein hain?
q.ar: كَمْ نَوْعاً مِنَ النَّظافَةِ يَذْكُرُ النَّصُّ؟

q.en: Who is responsible for private cleanliness?
q.ur: Khaas safai ki zimmedari kis par hai?
«مُتَحَضِّرٌ» ka matlab:

q.en: Where does a citizen put household waste?
q.ur: Shehri ghar ka kooda kahan dalta hai?
Kaun si aam jagah hai?

title.en: Dropping the nūn in a possessive phrase

intro.en: When the dual or sound masculine plural is followed by the thing it belongs to (iḍāfa), the final ن is dropped. Example: القَلَمانِ جَديدانِ (the two pens are new) but قَلَما سَعيدٍ (Saeed's two pens); مُسْلِمونَ مِنَ الهِنْدِ but مُسْلِمو الهِنْدِ (Muslims of India).
intro.ur: Jab muthanna ya jama muzakkar salim ke baad mudaf-ilaih aaye (izafat) to aakhri ن gir jata hai. Misaal: القَلَمانِ جَديدانِ (do qalam naye hain) lekin قَلَما سَعيدٍ (Saeed ke do qalam); مُسْلِمونَ مِنَ الهِنْدِ lekin مُسْلِمو الهِنْدِ (Hind ke Musalman).
intro.ar: إِذا جاءَ بَعْدَ المُثَنّى أَوْ جَمْعِ المُذَكَّرِ السّالِمِ ما يُضافُ إِلَيْهِ تُحْذَفُ النّونُ الأَخيرَةُ. مِثالٌ: القَلَمانِ جَديدانِ، وَلَكِنْ: قَلَما سَعيدٍ. مُسْلِمونَ مِنَ الهِنْدِ، وَلَكِنْ: مُسْلِمو الهِنْدِ.

intro.en: Practise writing short texts. Topics: «كَيْفَ أُحافِظُ عَلى نَظافَةِ مَسْكَني وَبَيْتي» (How I keep my home clean), retelling the fast-food dialogue as a story, «النَّظافَةُ في الإِسْلامِ» (Cleanliness in Islam), and a paragraph comparing private and public cleanliness.
intro.ur: Chhote matn likhne ki mashq. Mauzu: «كَيْفَ أُحافِظُ عَلى نَظافَةِ مَسْكَني وَبَيْتي» (main apne ghar ki safai kaise rakhta hoon), fast food wale mukaalme ko kahani ki shakal mein likhna, «النَّظافَةُ في الإِسْلامِ» (Islam mein safai), aur zaati aur aam safai ka muqabla.
intro.ar: تَدَرَّبْ عَلى كِتابَةِ نُصوصٍ قَصيرَةٍ. مِنَ المَوْضوعاتِ: «كَيْفَ أُحافِظُ عَلى نَظافَةِ مَسْكَني وَبَيْتي»، وَإِعادَةُ حِوارِ الوَجَباتِ السَّريعَةِ عَلى شَكْلِ قِصَّةٍ، وَ«النَّظافَةُ في الإِسْلامِ»، وَفَقْرَةٌ تُقارِنُ بَيْنَ النَّظافَةِ الخاصَّةِ وَالعامَّةِ.

intro.en: Practise Ruq'ah calligraphy with the verse «قُلْ إِنْ كُنْتُمْ تُحِبُّونَ اللَّهَ فَاتَّبِعوني يُحْبِبْكُمُ اللَّهُ». Spelling rule: the ة (tā' marbūṭa) becomes ت before a pronoun or the dual (حَقيبَة → حَقيبَتي، سَيّارَة → سَيّارَتانِ) and is dropped before the plural ending ـات (فاطِمَة → فاطِمات).
intro.ur: Ruqah khat ki mashq, ayat «قُلْ إِنْ كُنْتُمْ تُحِبُّونَ اللَّهَ فَاتَّبِعوني يُحْبِبْكُمُ اللَّهُ» ke saath. Imla ka qaida: ة (ta marbuta) zameer ya tasniya se pehle ت ban jati hai (حَقيبَة → حَقيبَتي، سَيّارَة → سَيّارَتانِ) aur jama ـات se pehle gir jati hai (فاطِمَة → فاطِمات).
intro.ar: تَدَرَّبْ عَلى خَطِّ الرُّقْعَةِ بِالآيَةِ: «قُلْ إِنْ كُنْتُمْ تُحِبُّونَ اللَّهَ فَاتَّبِعوني يُحْبِبْكُمُ اللَّهُ». قاعِدَةُ الإِمْلاءِ: تَصيرُ التّاءُ المَرْبوطَةُ تاءً مَبْسوطَةً قَبْلَ الضَّميرِ وَالمُثَنّى (حَقيبَتي، سَيّارَتانِ)، وَتُحْذَفُ قَبْلَ نِهايَةِ جَمْعِ المُؤَنَّثِ «ـات» (فاطِمات).

intro.en: A review of Units 9 and 10: reading an email message, multiple choice questions, opposites, synonyms, grammar choices (e.g. سَيّارَتانِ, بِمَ) and a short reading about a family that ate out and got sick.
intro.ur: Unit 9 aur 10 ki dohrai: email ka paigham parhna, multiple choice sawal, mutazaad aur hum-maani alfaz, grammar ke intikhabat (jaise سَيّارَتانِ، بِمَ) aur ek khandan ke bahar khane se beemar hone ka chhota matn.
intro.ar: مُراجَعَةٌ لِلْوَحْدَتَيْنِ التّاسِعَةِ وَالعاشِرَةِ: قِراءَةُ رِسالَةٍ إِلِكْتْرونِيَّةٍ، وَأَسْئِلَةُ الاخْتِيارِ مِنْ مُتَعَدِّدٍ، وَالأَضْدادُ وَالمُرادِفاتُ، وَاخْتِيارُ الصَّوابِ في القَواعِدِ، وَنَصٌّ قَصيرٌ عَنْ أُسْرَةٍ تَناوَلَتِ العَشاءَ في مَطْعَمٍ فَمَرِضَتْ.

dialogue.ar: يا مُحَمَّدُ ابْعَثْ لي هَذِهِ الرِّسالَةَ بِالبَريدِ الإِلِكْتِرونِيِّ إِلى المُوَظَّفِ يوسُفَ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ في الدَّمّامِ.
dialogue.tr: yā Muḥammad ibʿath lī hādhihi r-risālata bi-l-barīdi l-iliktrūnī ilā l-muwaẓẓafi Yūsufa ʿAbdi r-Raḥmān fī d-Dammām
dialogue.en: Muhammad, send me this message by email to the employee Yusuf Abdurrahman in Dammam.
dialogue.ur: Muhammad, yeh paigham email ke zariye Dammam mein mulazim Yusuf Abdurrahman ko bhejo.

dialogue.ar: وَاطْلُبْ مِنْهُ أَنْ يَحْضُرَ إِلَيْنا هُنا في الرِّياضِ، بَعْدَ شَهْرِ رَمَضانَ مُباشَرَةً.
dialogue.tr: waṭlub minhu an yaḥḍura ilaynā hunā fī r-Riyāḍ, baʿda shahri Ramaḍān mubāsharatan
dialogue.en: And ask him to come to us here in Riyadh, right after the month of Ramadan.
dialogue.ur: Aur us se kaho ke woh Ramazan ke fauran baad hamare paas Riyadh aaye.

dialogue.ar: حَتّى نُدْخِلَ الشَّبَكَةَ الدَّوْلِيَّةَ إِلى شَرِكَتِنا في اليَمَنِ، كَما فَعَلْنا في شَرِكَتِنا في الأُرْدُنِّ.
dialogue.tr: ḥattā nudkhila sh-shabakata d-dawliyya ilā sharikatinā fī l-Yaman, kamā faʿalnā fī sharikatinā fī l-Urdunn
dialogue.en: So that we bring the internet into our company in Yemen, as we did in our company in Jordan.
dialogue.ur: Taake hum Yemen mein apni company mein internet laayein, jaise hum ne Jordan ki company mein kiya.

q.ur: "Email" ke liye kaun sa lafz hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ كَلِمَةٍ تَعْني رَسائِلَ تُرْسَلُ عَبْرَ الحاسوبِ؟

q.en: In the email text, when should Yusuf come to Riyadh?
q.ur: Email mein Yusuf ko Riyadh kab aana hai?
q.ar: في رِسالَةِ البَريدِ، مَتى يَأْتي يوسُفُ إِلى الرِّياضِ؟
